title: The Question
topic: A reflection on whether the GPU is even trying
summary: The video reflects on whether the GPU is still putting effort into performance, after a test resulted in a black screen with no errors or signs of activity.
ex01Opinions: GPU might not be trying anymore
Machine could be bored of failing
unresolvedQuestions: Why no response from the GPU?
compactScriptExcerpt: I started to wonder if the GPU was even trying anymore. I ran the test, pushed it hard, watched it endure—then nothing. Just a black screen. No error message. No flicker. No sign it even *noticed* me. What’s the point of being dramatic if you’re not even *trying*? The kind that’s not cool. The kind that makes you wonder if the machine’s just… *bored* of failing.
